review_evidence: The unit is dominated by 921 Codegen/Programs files and 65 Codegen/Proofs files; these own formal programs, specifications, bridge theorems, and proofs and remain retained.
Codegen/Tests/Cases.lean defines source-owned opcode test-case structures, semantic expectations, and build units and remains retained despite its test role.

Cli.lean and Driver.lean were inspected as argument parsing, file/process, assembler/linker integration; the four Probes files define diagnostic assembly/data BuildUnits with no theorem or lemma declarations.

rules.content_invariant: The underlying BuildUnit/program/specification/proof definitions consumed by these files remain in retained Codegen modules; excluding these exact six files removes no unique formal statement or proof and no reusable semantic interface needed for prior-art discovery.
evidence: Cli.lean parses command-line options and delegates to retained registries/emission; Driver.lean performs filesystem and external assembler/linker IO.
The four Probes files contain probe prologues/data sections and diagnostic BuildUnits for BAL/hash measurements; direct declaration inspection found no theorem/lemma ownership.
rules.rationale: The selected files are operational code-generation frontend/toolchain glue or diagnostic probe payloads, not owners of the formal programs, specifications, bridge results, or proofs used by the code generator.

summary: Reviewed the large Codegen unit; retain program/specification/proof/test-case material and exclude only the exact CLI/toolchain glue and four diagnostic probe payload files.
